capabilities: push and pull vault changes to an S3 bucket via git
resolve merge conflicts between local and remote repos
show sync state in the status bar
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to back up and sync a vault to your own S3 storage with git-style version history and conflict resolution.

requires.name: git and git-lfs installed on the system
AWS access key and secret with S3 read/write access
AWS account with an S3 bucket

summary: Git-based backup and sync plugin that stores a vault's git repository in an S3 bucket, with commit history and merge conflict handling.
